title: Trump’s offer on US energy | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Donald Trump, Senate, Miss Universe

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Deal or no deal for PH? Trump’s offer on US energy, agri products

blocks.text: Philippine officials explain why U.S. President Donald Trump’s buy only American farm products and energy doesn’t fly.

items: Senate passes 2027 OP budget in two minutes

blocks.text: The Senate swiftly approves the P10 billion proposed budget of the Office of the President for 2027 in just two minutes.

items: Senate prioritizes feeding program in push for higher 2027 DepEd budget

blocks.text: Senator Bam Aquino recommends making the school-based feeding program the top priority for additional budget allocation among other Department of Education programs in 2027.

items: Pope Leo calls COP31 failure ‘troubling,’ urges action on climate change

blocks.text: Pope Leo XIV sharply criticizes the failure of UN climate talks, calling the outcome ‘troubling’ and urging world leaders to step up efforts to combat climate change.

items: Philippines’ Bea Millan-Windorski finishes 3rd runner-up at Miss Universe 2026

blocks.text: The Philippines’ bet Bea Millan-Windorski finishes third runner-up at the 75th Miss Universe in Puerto Rico. – Rappler.com
